code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia and respiratory acidosis, with low arterial oxygen and pH. There is leukopenia, neutropenia, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, LDH), suggesting significant inflammation or infection. Elevated INR and low platelets indicate coagulopathy. Liver enzymes show mild cholestasis. Findings are concerning for severe infection (possibly sepsis), hypoxic respiratory failure, and risk of bleeding; urgent clinical evaluation is recommended.
